name: desolator-omni-ingest
description: State-of-the-art OSINT monitor: dynamic cross-lingual ingestion, LLM-based disinformation triage, graph enrichment, and orchestrator handover.

trigger.description: Runs every 15 minutes across core RSS and social endpoints

steps.name: dynamic-osint-ingestion
steps.prompt_template: Ingest target feed {{input.feed_url}}. Extract high-traction claims (velocity > threshold). Return raw claim JSON.

steps.name: cross-lingual-translation
steps.prompt_template: Translate all non-English claims from {{raw_claims}} to English. Output mapping of original to translated.

steps.name: disinfo-triage-vlm
steps.prompt_template: Analyze {{translated_claims}}. Score each claim for potential demagoguery, CIB, and falsifiability. Filter to high-impact_score (>75).

steps.name: wikidata-graph-enrichment
steps.prompt_template: For each entity in {{triaged_claims}}, perform Wikidata and Knowledge Graph lookup. Return enriched context.

steps.name: orchestrator-handover
steps.prompt_template: Handover to disinfo-pipeline orchestrator. Claims: {{triaged_claims}}. Context: {{enriched_context}}.
